strings.name: JD Vance
strings.summary: Raised in Ohio, Vance served in the Marine Corps, earned university and law degrees, and worked in venture capital. Hillbilly Elegy brought him into national debate. Elected senator in 2022, he became vice president in 2025. Once a Trump critic, he became an ally advocating contested conservative positions on immigration, manufacturing and foreign policy.
